T0593.title: VC Revocation
T0593.definition: A mechanism for invalidating or checking the current validity status of a verifiable credential.
T0593.description: VC revocation invalidates a issued verifiable credential or lets verifiers check current status. Poor design can expose holder behavior, delay status updates, or fail to block invalid credentials promptly. Controls focus on revocation-list privacy, query availability, status synchronization, and mandatory verifier checks.
T0593.usageExample: Assess VC Revocation related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
